subject: history
concept: Writing an evidence-based civic essay analyzing a governmental structure or process, using the student's interest profile
source_inspiration: original content — not sourced from any external text

exercise.pictorial: Student plans their essay using a claim/evidence/analysis organizer
exercise.abstract: Student writes an essay analyzing a governmental structure, process, or right, supported by specific evidence

assessment.mastery_threshold: essay makes a clear analytical claim supported by specific evidence
misconception_flags: describes a governmental process without making any analytical claim about it

interest_binding: topic generated fresh from student's stated interest profile where possible
